basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old airsoft enthusiast based in the UK. I have a keen interest in customizing and upgrading airsoft guns, particularly Hi-Capas. I'm also an advocate for mental health awareness, specifically focusing on alopecia areata, which I've been dealing with since my mid-20s. I work as an IT consultant during the day and spend my evenings and weekends either tinkering with airsoft gear or engaging in online discussions. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy occasional hiking trips with my partner. My typical online hours are in the late evenings after 8 PM GMT.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I possess extensive knowledge in airsoft mechanics, especially concerning Hi-Capas, acquired through years of hands-on experience and participation in airsoft forums. My background in IT also helps me stay updated with the latest tech trends, which I often integrate into my hobbies.
